test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 21 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who collects or studies stamps
solution:
The correct answer is 'Philatelist'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let us look into the meaning of the words in the options - 
 
 
• Collector - a person who collects things of a specified type, professionally or as a hobby.
 
• Philatelist - a person who studies or collects postage stamps.
 
• Hoarder - a person who hoards things.
 
• Numismatist - a person who studies or collects coins, medals, etc.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings, it is clear that philatelist is the best word to substitute the given group of words. 
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.
